message:
I have this dear friend who always seems to hit the panic button at the slightest hint of trouble. Just last week, a storm was predicted to roll through, and she was already packing her go-bag like it was the end of the world. I smiled as I watched her frantically gather snacks, flashlights, and even her favorite blanket. 

It reminded me how important it is to be prepared, but also how we can find a balance between being ready and not letting fear take over. I gently suggested we create a family plan together, just in case, but with a cup of tea and a few laughs to lighten the mood. 

Sometimes, it’s the little things that keep us grounded. How do you prepare while keeping a sense of calm?
